aggregation: Median of three per-round medians. Paired ratios divide before by after within each round; ratio of aggregated medians is reported separately.
timing_interpretation: CPU view/recording, CPU submission, GPU queries and full-frame readback are distinct intervals. GPU queries exclude upfront renderer preparation and geometry/instance uploads, but include on-demand palette texture creation/update inside draw_shaded; they are not pure shader time. Do not sum CPU and GPU or infer pipelined FPS. Retained process/GPU memory includes caches. Clocks are observed without power-setting changes; shared desktop applications remain running.
gpu_query_boundary: Excludes upfront renderer preparation and geometry/instance uploads. Includes on-demand palette texture creation/update inside draw_shaded, plus shader drawing; excludes framebuffer readback. GPU query is not pure shader execution time.
